stops.note: to scatter, to sprinkle, combined with ad- (toward)
to sprinkle on, from ad- and spargere
a sprinkling, later a damaging remark spread about someone, from aspergere
settled as the English word for a critical or damaging remark about someone
stops.meaning: a critical or damaging remark about someone

current_meaning: a critical or damaging remark that questions someone's character or reputation
